## Core Stack & Engineering Focus
- Frameworks & UI: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Vite
- Styling & Systems: Tailwind CSS v4, CSS Tokens, Responsive UI, Full RTL/LTR Parity, Figma
- State & Data: Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query
- Testing & Quality: Vitest, React Testing Library, Web Accessibility (WCAG AA), Semantic HTML
- Performance: Core Web Vitals optimization, static site generation (SSG), minimal bundle size

## Key Systems & Projects
- Ganotic: https://ganotic.ir
  - Founder & Lead Front-End/Design.
  - Health & wellness e-commerce PWA built with Next.js, React admin dashboard, and shared design system tokens.
- MSSP (Health Surveillance System): https://mssp.inhso.ir
  - Progressive Web App (PWA) supporting epidemiology workflows and offline capabilities.
  - Complex interactive data visualizations and charts built with Recharts.
- Payesh (National Healthcare Analytics Dashboard): https://payesh.inhso.ir
  - Large-scale national analytics platform handling high-density data tables and advanced state management.
- PicoPet: https://picopet.ir
  - Fluid, responsive e-commerce application with modern cart interactions and high performance.
